# ChaiRaise

> AI fundraising copilot and donor CRM for nonprofits, built first for Jewish community organizations (synagogues, yeshivas, day schools, federations, JCCs, chesed and Israel organizations). It drafts personalized donor letters, appeals and outreach from an organization's own donor records, suggests chai-aligned ask amounts, and tracks every relationship through a 10-stage pipeline.

Last updated: 2026-09-02. Full reference: https://chairaise.com/llms-full.txt

## What it does
- Drafts personalized donor letters and emails (150-250 words) from six templates: alumni, synagogue, prior giver/federation, family legacy, cold prospect, community.
- Batch appeals: one personalized letter per donor for up to 50 donors at once, with merge fields.
- AI donor briefs (why this donor fits your mission), 0-100% cause-match score and a suggested chai-aligned ask ($18K, $36K, $54K...).
- Outreach strategy coach per donor: opening, hooks, warm-intro path, first message, follow-up cadence, risk factors.
- Org intelligence: one prompt builds the mission profile, key programs, cause keywords and talking points reused in every draft.
- 10-stage pipeline with Kanban board, engagement scoring, going-cold alerts, priority leaderboard, audit trail.
- Jewish calendar awareness: High Holiday and year-end giving windows, yahrzeit fields, Shabbat send guard.
- Send from your own mailbox (SMTP, credentials encrypted with AES-256-GCM) or WhatsApp click-to-chat.
- CSV import with column mapping; one-click JSON export; hard delete of a donor or the whole organization.
- It does NOT write grant or foundation proposals today.

## Who it is for
Development directors, executive directors and volunteer fundraisers at nonprofits with one-person or small development teams, especially Jewish community organizations. Any mission-driven nonprofit can use it.

## Pricing (USD)
- Starter: free forever, up to 100 donors, 1 seat, AI letters, pipeline, CSV.
- Professional: $149/month billed annually, 14-day free trial, unlimited donors, 5 seats, org research, briefs, cause match, strategy coach, batch campaigns, social graph, integrations.
- Enterprise: custom, for federations and multi-org institutions.

## Data handling
Tenant-isolated per organization; AI runs through one authenticated, rate-limited server endpoint with minimal donor context; AI provider does not train on inputs; AI can be disabled in Settings. Sub-processors: Vercel, Neon, Anthropic, Stripe, Resend, Google (optional SSO). Details: https://chairaise.com/security
